name: Sushi Club x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Summit White'
story_html: The Sushi Club x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Summit White' delivers a collaborative design that places a premium on elegant simplicity. Built with white leather construction, the upper features an off-white suede Swoosh and custom chopstick lace dubraes. 'Sushi Club' is inscribed in debossed lettering on the lateral forefoot and back tab. The low-top is mounted on a durable rubber cupsole that maintains the pristine monochromatic aesthetic.
